jobs.description: Work @ everii Du denkst Produkte nicht in Features, sondern vom echten Bedarf der Nutzer aus? Du willst Strategie, Kundenfeedback und technische Möglichkeiten zusammenbringen – und unser Produkt vom ersten Tag an mitgestalten? Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen! Was dich erwartet Als Produkt-Manager denkst du vom Kunden aus – und von übermorgen her. Du kennst die Welt von Agenturen, Beratungen und IT-Dienstleistern: wie sie planen, abrechnen, kommunizieren, wachsen. Dieses Verständnis nutzt du, um nicht nur das nächste Feature zu durchdenken, sondern die Richtung des Produkts mitzubestimmen. Du arbeitest im engen Austausch mit Entwicklung und Customer Operations, bringst Kundenfeedback, die technische und strategische Perspektive zusammen – und hilfst dem Team, die richtigen Entscheidungen zur richtigen Zeit zu treffen. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Konzeption: Du fragst zuerst nach dem Warum. Die eigentliche Anforderung hinter einem Feature Request ist dein Ausgangspunk. Von dort denkst du Lösungsansätze ganzheitlich durch und bereitest sie präzise für die Entwicklung auf. Produkt-Design: Figma ist dir vertraut, und du hast ein Auge für Design – du erkennst, was ein Interface intuitiv, klar und angenehm nutzbar macht. Nah am User: Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit Kunden, challengest Annahmen und weißt, was wirklich gebraucht und nicht nur laut gewünscht wird. Testing & QA: Du begleitest die Umsetzung aktiv, gibst Feedback im Prozess und stellst sicher, dass das fertige Feature die ursprüngliche Anforderung trifft. Blick auf das große Ganze: Du denkst unser Produkt nicht feature-weise, sondern in Richtungen. Du erkennst Muster in Kundenfeedback, Marktentwicklung und technischen Möglichkeiten – und hilfst dem Team, daraus klare Prioritäten zu machen. Blog & Handbuch: Du erklärst, was neu ist und warum es wichtig ist. Kurz, prägnant, und ohne Buzzwords Gutes Schreiben ist für dich kein Pflichtprogramm, sondern Teil der Arbeit. Und wenn ein Club eine Frage hat, sind wir da. Du kennst PC CADDIE aus dem Clubsekretariat oder vom Empfang? Oder Du kommst aus dem Kundenservice und hast einen Draht zum Golfsport? Dann passt Du zu uns. PC CADDIE ist die Clubsoftware für über 700 Golfanlagen und Verbände in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz und weiteren Ländern. Unser Support-Team arbeitet remote, verteilt über alle drei Länder im DACH, und betreut die Clubs persönlich. Deine Aufgaben Du beantwortest Fragen der Clubs zu PC CADDIE am Telefon, per Ticket und per Fernwartung. Du findest heraus, wo es hakt, und löst es selbst oder holst die passenden Kolleg:innen dazu. Du richtest Funktionen ein und passt sie an die Abläufe des Clubs an. Du schulst Clubteams online und vor Ort. Du teilst deine Arbeit selbst ein und übernimmst im Wechsel die Verteilung der eingehenden Anfragen. Mit der Zeit wächst du in ein Fachteam hinein. Das bringst du mit Schön, wenn Du PC CADDIE schon als Anwenderin oder Anwender kennst und noch besser, wenn Du Französisch sprichst. Die Technik dahinter bringen wir dir bei: mit strukturierter Einarbeitung und festen Ansprechpersonen. Das bekommst du bei uns Planbare Arbeitszeiten, überwiegend Mo. bis Fr. Ein faires Gehalt, über das wir im Gespräch offen sprechen. Fortbildungen und einen klaren Weg zur Spezialistin oder zum Spezialisten. Ein Team, das hinter dir steht und gern hilft. So bewirbst du dich Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Sätze dazu, warum du Lust auf PC CADDIE hast. Deine Bewerbung behandeln wir vertraulich, auch gegenüber deinem jetzigen Arbeitgeber

jobs.title: Engineering Fellowship
jobs.description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. You own a project end to end: understand the problem, decide how to approach it, build the solution, and get it into use. The work depends on where you can have the most impact. You could build background coding agents, create a frontend component library, or solve an operational problem with agents. The common thread is a meaningful problem, a clear outcome, and ownership of getting it done. You’ll work closely with the team your project sits in. jobs.description: About Us Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms. Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development. The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C. The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption. A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Protein Design & Engineering
jobs.description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why. This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it. What you'll do Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and characterisation of improved variants. Build and express variant libraries using site-directed, random, and combinatorial mutagenesis. Develop assays and high-throughput screens that reliably measure the properties we're trying to improve. jobs.title: Head of Product - H/F
jobs.description: Vos missions Vos missions Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise. jobs.title: Scientific Account Executive
jobs.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers — from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs. The day-to-day: Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

jobs.title: Head of Marketing (m/f/d)
jobs.description: 80% of the world's workforce doesn't sit at a desk. Ordio 💙 is the all-in-one platform that helps these teams run their day: shift planning, time tracking, absence & document management. Simple, fast, and human. We're at an exciting stage of growth: around €5m ARR , with strong foundations in DACH, new products in market, and international expansion underway. Marketing now has the opportunity to become a major growth lever for the business connecting brand, demand generation, product and sales into one commercial engine. We’re looking for a senior, commercially minded marketing leader to build and scale Ordio’s marketing engine for the next stage of growth. You’ll own Marketing end to end, with clear accountability for pipeline, new ARR and efficient growth . You’ll work closely with the CEO, Sales and Product to sharpen our positioning, scale acquisition, improve conversion, and expand a successful GTM motion into new European markets. The opportunity is to build the next version of Ordio’s marketing organisation and grow with the company toward a true CMO level role as Ordio scales toward €20–50m ARR . Tasks Own Ordio’s marketing strategy, budget and operating cadence, with a clear focus on pipeline, customers, ARR, CAC and payback . Build and scale a measurable demand generation engine across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, organic, content and SEO . Go deep into campaign performance, creative, landing pages and conversion — not just manage agencies or dashboards. Own the full funnel from first touch through Closed Won , including lifecycle, CRM, nurture and conversion optimisation. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services. Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. About the Team Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design. Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools. Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Lautsprecher prägen den Sound von ausgewählten Clubs, Festivals, Bars, Hotels und Restaurants weltweit. Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig. Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest. Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis. Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international. Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Als Marktführer in der Kieferorthopädie und mit einer großen Finanzierungsrunde im Rücken skalieren wir nun in andere medizinische Fachbereiche - und du bist an vorderster Front dabei. Als Customer Success Manager setzt du neue Standards für moderne Kundenbetreuung und -entwicklung und übernimmst die End-to-End Betreuung unserer Kunden und hilfst dabei, Kunden pro-aktiv zum Erfolg mit unserem Produkt zu führen. Wieso praxipal? Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzen wird. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten. Wir wachsen in Rekordgeschwindigkeit und haben vor kurzem eine Seed-Finanzierungsrunde in Höhe von $6.7 Millionen mit HV Capital abgeschlossen - und wir fangen gerade erst an. Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten – aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager in our Berlin or London offices. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (ML QA)
jobs.description: About the job Build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware. You’ll design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. Your work will help teams deliver reliable products, with clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack. You’ll architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. You’ll create representative ML workloads, analyse their execution and turn the results into practical improvements to testing and tooling. This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems. You’ll deepen your understanding of the AI compute stack while solving engineering problems that connect software design with hardware behaviour. The team and culture Graphcore’s ML QA engineers build automation, work with industry-standard frameworks and models, and contribute to upstream open-source projects. You’ll work across software teams, using code and design reviews to strengthen quality, security and maintainability. You’ll use workload results to challenge assumptions and guide technical decisions about how Graphcore tests its ML stack. You’ll own improvements, act quickly on testing gaps and mentor junior engineers to raise the team’s technical standards. What we’re looking for Strong Python skills, demonstrated through designing, developing and maintaining production-quality software. Software design and architecture skills for large, complex codebases, with a focus on testability and long-term maintainability. Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems in Linux environments. Familiarity with C or C++, including the ability to read, debug and reason about low-level code. The ability to mentor junior engineers and influence engineering practices through construct

jobs.title: Senior SoC Architect
jobs.description: Shape the high-speed interfaces and silicon sub-systems behind Graphcore’s next AI acceleration platforms. As a Senior SoC Architect in Bristol, you’ll translate product requirements into specifications for complex, highly integrated, high-performance silicon devices. You’ll own sub-system architecture, modelling, validation and evaluation, connecting early design choices with practical implementation. You’ll help determine how critical components work together, balancing product needs with implementation trade-offs. Those choices will support the specialised compute that lets AI innovators tackle more demanding problems. You’ll assess third-party hard and soft IP, work with vendors and specify how sub-systems integrate across the platform. You’ll also contribute to silicon bring-up, characterisation and evaluation when your expertise is needed. Your contribution won’t stop at a specification document. You’ll deepen your understanding of AI acceleration by seeing how architectural decisions play out in working silicon. The team and culture Reporting to the Director of Silicon Architecture, you will be working with processor, SoC and system architects. Silicon design, verification, hardware and software engineers are partners in evaluating options and checking implementation correctness. You’ll represent the team in cross-functional working groups, making trade-offs clear and speaking up when designs need further scrutiny. You’ll help teams move forward by resolving complex bugs and improving engineering processes. Mentoring engineers will let you share your judgement and help others develop theirs. What we’re looking for A degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science or a related subject. A solid understanding of computer and SoC architecture. Experience writing clear technical specifications. Knowledge of RTL development and verification processes. The ability to explain design choices clearly and work across engineering teams. Confidence

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

jobs.description: About Alma At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we ve empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we re just getting started! About the team Strategic Finance is part of Alma s Finance team and reports to the CFO. Our job is to understand Alma s economics better than anyone: we own the top line, the unit economics and the Contribution Margin, and we turn that knowledge into decisions on pricing, partnerships, markets and products. We are organising the team so that each person owns a piece of Alma s P&L from start to finish: its business plan, its recurring analysis, its key finance processes, its business partners and its Board materials. Depending on the scope, that piece can be payments and partnerships, our existing merchant base, or new business and growth, each with one or more European markets attached. About the job Own your piece of the P&L. Build and maintain its business plan, follow its performance month after month, and explain what moves the numbers and why, all the way up to the Board. Vos missions : Rattaché(e) au service Qualité, et sous le tutorat de notre Ingénieur Qualité et système, vous participez à l’animation et à l’amélioration du SMQ, en collaboration avec les différents services de l’entreprise. À ce titre, vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Gestion documentaire : participer à la rédaction, à la mise à jour et à la maîtrise des procédures, processus, modes opératoires et autres documents du SMQ ; Amélioration continue : contribuer à l’identification des axes de progrès et proposer des actions visant à améliorer l’efficacité des processus ; Audits qualité : participer à la préparation et à la réalisation des audits internes, ainsi qu’au suivi des écarts et des plans d’actions associés ; Suivi des non-conformités : contribuer à l’analyse des causes, au suivi des actions correctives et préventives et à l’évaluation de leur efficacité ; Pilotage des indicateurs : participer à la définition, à la mise à jour et à l’analyse des indicateurs de performance du SMQ ; Conformité normative : contribuer au maintien de la conformité du système aux exigences de la norme ISO 9001 et aux référentiels applicables ; Sensibilisation qualité : accompagner les équipes dans l’appropriation des processus et des exigences qualité ; Démarche d’amélioration du SMQ : participer à la préparation des revues de processus et de direction et contribuer au suivi des décisions prises. Ces missions pourront évoluer au fil de votre alternance, en fonction de votre progression et des projets d’amélioration engagés. Vous préparez une formation de niveau Bac5 en management de la qualité, génie industriel, management des systèmes ou équivalent, et recherchez une alternance vous permettant de développer vos compétences en système de management de la qua

jobs.title: Gestionnaire facturation (h/f)
jobs.description: Vos missions au quotidien Rattaché au service facturation, vous intervenez en support opérationnel pour garantir la gestion et la fluidité des flux de facturation. Vous gérez la boîte e-mails dédiée au service et traitez les demandes entrantes, puis vous effectuez la saisie des avoirs fabricants dans le système de gestion. Vous prenez également en charge les litiges de facturation liés aux quantités ou à la qualité des produits, en lien direct avec les différents services. Ce que nous recherchons Vous disposez d'une première expérience sur un poste similaire et maîtrisez les processus de facturation. Votre rigueur et votre sens du service vous permettent de traiter efficacement les demandes et les litiges au sein d'une équipe à taille humaine. Vos premiers mois Dès votre arrivée à Ivry-sur-Seine dans le cadre de ce contrat de quatre mois à 39 heures par semaine, vous prenez en main la boîte e-mails du service et apprenez à saisir les avoirs fabricants. Vous collaborez rapidement avec les autres services pour résoudre les premiers litiges de facturation et sécuriser les flux de données. Avantages et rémunération Vous bénéficiez d'une mutuelle santé et d'une participation aux frais de transports publics, ainsi que de 25 jours de congés payés par an. La rémunération est comprise entre EUR 28,000 et 29,000 par an. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Mon Courtier Énergie est un acteur majeur du courtage en énergie en France. Nous accompagnons les professionnels (TPE, PME, collectivités, industriels…) dans la maîtrise et l’optimisation de leurs dépenses énergétiques, à travers un service complet : comparaison d’offres, accompagnement fournisseur, consulting, solutions vertes, bornes électriques et rénovations énergétiques. Créé en France et aujourd’hui fort de plus de 200 collaborateurs répartis dans 34 agences en France et à l’étranger, notre groupe affiche une croissance constante et des ambitions fortes. Votre rôle Au sein de l’agence de Villeneuve d'Ascq, vous intégrerez une équipe soudée et dynamique ! Votre mission : créer et développer un portefeuille client en BtoB et accompagner vos interlocuteurs dans le choix de solutions énergétiques adaptées à leurs besoins. Suivre votre activité via les outils CRM et reporting mis à disposition. Votre profil Vous justifiez d’une première expérience commerciale réussie, idéalement en BtoB ou dans l’énergie. Goût prononcé pour la prospection, le contact client et la négociation. Autonome, persévérant(e) et orienté(e) résultats. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et partagez des valeurs de solidarité et de performance. Ce que nous offrons Fixe 24000 € + primes déplafonnées (moyenne an 1 : 35K€, an 2 : 55K€) Avantages (tickets resto, mutuelle, transports, véhicule de service). Vous organisez le rendez-vous : le fondateur assure la démonstration et le closing. 🏡 PropertyOS, c’est quoi ? PropertyOS est une plateforme SaaS qui centralise les biens immobiliers, les locataires, les finances, les documents et les tâches dans un même espace. jobs.description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far. Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.
